notes: Downloads now open a window with a progress bar, and pressing Back twice cancels one. The browser waits in that window until the pack is in: the game fetches one file at a time, so pack art and previews would only stall behind it anyway. On the ITG System Image, packs can now go straight onto your songs drive — after updating, quit to System Mode and run the installer again (the browser reminds you once). Nothing to do anywhere else.
